Ashgate Hospice urges residents to book Treecycle tree collection

Collected trees are chipped in partnership with Jake Eville Tree Care to create biomass fuel

  • By NOTICEBOARD
  • •19 November 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:07
Instaread

Residents across North Derbyshire can turn their used Christmas trees into vital funding for specialist local care this festive season. Ashgate Hospice is urging households to choose a real tree and sign up for its annual Treecycle collection service once the celebrations end.

For a suggested donation of £15, friendly volunteers will pick up real trees directly from homes and businesses between January 7, 2027 and January 12, 2027. The doorstep service covers postcodes across S18, S21, S40–S45, DE4, DE45, and DE55, saving families the hassle of clearing pine needles out of their cars.

Every tree collected is chipped in partnership with Jake Eville Tree Care and turned into biomass fuel and sustainable products instead of going to landfill. All money raised helps fund free palliative and end of life care - specialist comfort and support for people living with life-limiting illnesses - across North Derbyshire.

Ashgate Hospice needs to raise around £11m every year to run its services, with around a third coming from NHS funding and the rest reliant on community generosity. Organisers say signing up for Treecycle is an easy, eco-friendly way for local families to make a meaningful difference in the new year.

James Branson, events and community fundraising manager at Ashgate Hospice, said: "When people are choosing their Christmas tree this year, we'd love them to consider buying a real tree and signing up to Treecycle after the festive season.

"Not only is it an easy and convenient way to recycle your tree, but every donation helps us provide specialist care and support to patients and the people important to them, when they need us most.

"By choosing a real tree, you're making a greener choice and helping make a real difference to local people living with a life-limiting illness."

  • Date: January 7, 2027 to January 12, 2027
  • Location: Homes and businesses across S18, S21, S40–S45, DE4, DE45, and DE55
  • Cost: Suggested donation of £15 per tree

To find out more and register your tree, visit www.ashgatehospice.org/treecycle or call 01246 567 250.

Location: Buxton, Glossop, Matlock, Bakewell, Bolsover and Chesterfield, Derbyshire
